description: Fix 2 issues from review-v2: (1) DynStr/DynPrint returns 'None' for container refs instead of Python representation, (2) intPow returns 0 for negative exponents instead of a float.
steps: Step 1 - Add FormatDynamic to hostabi that renders any boxed value without requiring a source type, probing containers at runtime
Step 2 - Update DynStr and DynPrint in operator/dynamic.go to use FormatDynamic instead of FormatScalar
Step 3 - Fix intBinary to return BoxF64(math.Pow(float64(left), float64(right))) when op == DOUBLESTAR && right < 0
Step 4 - Add tests for str/print on containers and negative exponents
acceptance_criteria: str() on Any-typed list renders as '[1, 2, 3]' not 'None'
print() on Any-typed dict renders as '{1: 2}' not 'None'
